placeUrls.title: Google Maps place URLs
placeUrls.description: One or more Google Maps URLs for businesses you want reviews for. Example: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Central+Park/@40.7812,-73.9665,15z

placeUrl.title: Single place URL (alternative)
placeUrl.description: Single Google Maps URL. Used only if placeUrls is empty.

searchQueries.title: Search queries (alternative to URLs)
searchQueries.description: Business name plus city. Each query resolves to the first Google Maps match. Example: 'Eleven Madison Park New York'

maxReviews.title: Maximum reviews per business
maxReviews.description: Hard cap per business. Prevents runaway charges on places with thousands of reviews.

filterByRating.title: Filter by rating
filterByRating.description: Only return reviews with these star ratings. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. Leave empty for all ratings.

language.title: Language filter
language.description: Only return reviews in this language. Leave empty for all languages. Example: en, es, fr, de, it

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Residential proxies recommended for Google Maps.
